// MarshalFastJSONTo writes the fields Item declares, in that order.
func (x *Item) MarshalFastJSONTo(s *jsonstream.Stream) error {
	if x == nil {
		s.WriteNil()
		return nil
	}
	s.WriteObjectStart()
	if err := x.writeJSONFields(s); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.WriteObjectEnd()
	return nil
}

// writeJSONFields writes those fields without the enclosing object, for a type another object inlines.
func (x *Item) writeJSONFields(s *jsonstream.Stream) error {

	ethjson.Data(s, "hash", x.Hash[:])
	ethjson.Quantity(s, "index", x.Index)
	s.Field("flag").WriteBool(x.Flag)
	if x.Stamp != nil {
		ethjson.Quantity(s, "stamp", *x.Stamp)
	}
	if x.Null == nil {
		s.Field("null").WriteNil()
	} else {
		ethjson.Quantity(s, "null", *x.Null)
	}
	ethjson.Data(s, "payload", x.Payload[:])
	if x.OptStart != nil {
		ethjson.Quantity(s, "optStart", *x.OptStart)
	}
	if x.OptNum != 0 {
		ethjson.Quantity(s, "optNum", x.OptNum)
	}
	return nil
}
